description: Roll out multi-locale support for a web application: deploy 12 new locales (fr, de, es, pt-BR, ja, ko, zh-CN, zh-TW, ar, he, ru, hi) beyond the existing en locale. The rollout must follow: deploy locale/key files (translated message bundles), run the translation pipeline (machine translation pre-fill + human review for ja/zh/ko/ar/he), per-locale verification (RTL layout for ar/he, pluralization rules for ru/ar, date/number formatting, encoding/charset), progressive enable (enable locales in batches: en+fr+de first, then es+pt-BR, then ja+ko+zh-CN+zh-TW, then ar+he+ru+hi), and monitor (track missing keys, translation completeness, user locale adoption). A rollback plan must exist per batch (disable a locale if it causes rendering issues). Risk factors: RTL languages (ar, he) require CSS direction changes, pluralization rules differ by language, and CJK languages have different line-breaking behavior. Tools available: i18next, formatjs (ICU MessageFormat), Crowdin/Transifé, React i18next, Jest.
